notes.content:

All weapons+trigger
Ejector Gun + Alienator

notes.title: V0.8.240919 Updated, The DLC Supporter Pack has been released!
notes.content:
Since the release of the EA version in July, many commanders have joined our “extermination brigade” and successfully completed one extermination plan after another arranged by the organization. Without you guys, this blue star would have been devoured by the insects!

While on the mission, people don't forget to hit us up in the Steam comments section and various other channels to help us recruit more commanders to join the organization!
Your support and word-of-mouth publicity is very important to our two-person minuscule team. Thanks again for your love and support!

Now, “The big engineer” is sending out the [b]final sprint[/b] for the upcoming [b]full released[/b], in addition to the [b][Endless Mode][/b] that everyone is looking forward to, what kind of [b][Black Tech Weapons] and [Legacy of the Void][/b] will he bring to you?

I know you all can't wait either! Look, I've stolen some of his designs and put them in the 【Supporter Pack】to be publicized in this issue, so that you can have a good time first, and we'll present more content in the upcoming full released without any reservation, please stay tuned!

[b]The [Supporter Pack] will be updated via automatic to games that have currently purchased the Time Treker Early Access.[/b]

[h2]【Supporter Pack】[/h2]
As a thank you for your support, within two weeks of the [b]Full Released[/b] players who have purchased Time Treker [b] (including those who have now purchased the EA version)[/b] will be able to access the contents of this [Supporter Pack] for free!

notes.title: V0.8.2Upadte | New technologies arrive!
notes.content:
Commanders, long time no see. I am an engineer affiliated with the headquarters' arsenal. During this time, I have been working tirelessly and have developed a new technology - the "Potential Upgrade"!

Unlike the traditional way where only survival, combat, dexterity, and concentration can be enhanced by adding points, the "Potential Upgrade" customizes a unique plan for each commander to better showcase their specialties. Based on this, commanders can upgrade various modules in the plan to strengthen your mechas!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837717/61e2153f0f490460beb883cde2ad1bb474488ab4.png[/img]【"Veteran" McNulty】

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837717/f2884b0147fde041458242393a669cb62f7ea9a0.png[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837717/6da0d3b4ce3c4b4c19013c22fa3ba2cd64a5fa12.png[/img]【"Rebel" Meve】

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837717/f3755e56d3cca89fb0c1e2015fb7911912d8f562.png[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837717/5478d2f948dcb6df642a15c925de395640191382.png[/img]【"Genius" Alexa】

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837717/6084633d9949fa6ec35230b46a5a60f764d8593b.png[/img]

[b]【More Attribute Enhancements】[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837717/fd2cb83ea122047f62bbc4154e05f932e553a13d.png[/img]
【Aggressive Neurotoxin】、【Rebellion Neurotoxin】、【Reflex Neurotoxin】、【Active Neurotoxin】
These Neurotoxins can enhance the ability of the commanders, but be aware of its side effects~!

[b]【New Legacy】[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837717/ceaa31cfef2fb127d4d7541e243e11ab098adb4a.png[/img]
【Orbiting Satellite】 【Black Dice】 【Vortex Edge】 【Longshot Ring】
Provide different buffs to yourself and debuffs to enemies.

[b]【New Hero Coming Soon】[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837717/8171973f954444cfe93643404bc81e17e4517b12.png[/img]
Bug girl with unique skills... Just waiting for the next update!

[b]In this timeline operation, we have fixed the following issues:[/b]
*Fixed the problem of incorrect damage frequency of "Graviton Cannon" and "Electrostastic Controller" (the previous damage calculation method was incorrect).
* Fixed the problem of incomplete display of boss illustrations.
* Fixed the problem of display on the research center interface.
* Fixed the problem of ineffective refresh discounts in "Construction Levels".
*Fixed the problem of uncounted "Survival Expert" cumulative achievement.
* Fixed the problem that completing "Last Stand" multiple times in the same level but only recording the achievement once.

[b]Content experience optimization:[/b]
 *Added a "speed-up function" in the game.
*Optimized the problem of lag when there are too many enemies.
*Added the recycling function of inheritance and enhanced attributes.
*Added the one-click upgrade function in the warehouse.
*Added the display switch for the announcer lady and character text bubbles.
*Optimized the balance of weapons.
*Increased the number of enemies (especially in early levels).
*Increased the damage caused by late-stage enemies to characters.

notes.title: DEMO V0.1.240613 update content | Optimization & bug fixes

notes.title: Eastern Game Fest！ news contents preview!
notes.content:
Come check out the demo where you can customize your weapons and take on some seriously tough enemies-- 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2776500/_TimeTreker/

Got any thoughts or suggestions? We'd love to hear 'em! Just share your opinion in the community and shoot us your ideas to help us make TimeTreker even more awesome.

"TimeTreker" has been hard at work by a bunch of us, and we're almost there with the full version. Here's the latest rundown of recent update:
•Chrono Battlefield mode -- where you carve your way through endless battles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837717/38b9eb12a4dea7e0fa46a3d8921182c88ace0d05.jpg[/img]


•Void Legacy -- Passive skills for you to boost your power.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837717/778013ce16272ec393b0a17ca32a4c75d1835b92.jpg[/img]


•Enhancement System -- to give you a serious upgrade.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837717/ed6a766ea312734cc1a290819caf417e62e5bda8.jpg[/img]


• Building Blocks mode-- for a more varied gameplay experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837717/d35bd682bf9af2fa9573ef9e57a79ddf431b5406.jpg[/img]


•Remade the Weapons and Plugins display panels.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837717/f22a25f5775cc73545de33f8f35b95ac75a56ba2.jpg[/img]


•Remade the Tech Categories for some serious pre-battle prep.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837717/893072fedabd867c9720432d79a8f15c28c3731a.jpg[/img]

That's not all! We're still fine-tuning every little detail. See you soon!

notes.title: The last big update to the demo
notes.content:
What's updated:
Inspired by the emissaries of the player base, we've given the demo a big update

1. Support the use of controllers for gaming
2. The main weapon can be disassembled and replaced
3. In the settings, you can turn on "Auto Battle" and play a single-stick game
4. Added a new weapon "Chainsaw"
5. Adjusted the light effects of the environment and bullets to reduce light pollution
6. Enemy bullets are more obvious
7. Optimized the following logic of the floating cannon, so that the output will be more concentrated
8. Optimized the guidance of shortcut keys
9. Narrowed the area of the announcer's text prompt

We sincerely invite every player to join the QQ group: 469563452
We desperately need your feedback and discussion, both positive and negative!
In the future, we will focus on the development of the official version.
Thank you for your support!
